items.title: Lawrence Duhé Interview, 1957-06-09
items.q: Oh yeah, Bach-Ate, Bach-Ate, T.O. Oh yeah, that's bad. With all the arpeggios and the chords...

ctx.x: Yeah, he used to get around very fast on the clarinet. Yeah. Did the old time fellas though, like the T.O's and Warner and some of those, get all over the clarinet and the clarinet up high and low and... Oh, I don't know. Run all over the clarinet.

Oh yeah, Bach-Ate, Bach-Ate, T.O. Oh yeah, that's bad. With all the arpeggios and the chords, they didn't just stick to the melody of them. Oh, no, no, they didn't run up that scale. Somebody told me maybe they... Diminished, diminished with them. Yeah, all the different... Variations, kind of variation. Oh, it's really bad clarinet, Bach-Ate, T.O.
